title: Goosebumps: Revenge of the Lawn Gnomes
original_title: Goosebumps: Revenge of the Lawn Gnomes
overview: Joe and Mindy's father is always buying kitsch garden ornaments. His purchase of a set of lawn gnomes leads to chaos, however, as Joe discovers they are alive and intent on causing mayhem.
